name: Wood Siding (smooth) NC — QT3, Field Primed, New
doctrine: Method is not matched: prime tasks gate on application_method_prime, finish tasks on application_method (taxonomy section 4, per-coat). consumables[] is inert until the CON_ wiring lands (brief R2). Reference only, never a restriction or warning (Eric 2026-10-03): N1 FPL measured paint-life loss after ~1 wk sun on cedar/low-density wood, 3-4 wk dense species. N2 SW latex wood primer topcoat <=14 d; WRCLA: factory primers not intended for >90 d exposure. N3 MPI/FPL: wood MC <=15%, RH <=85%, surface 5 F over dew point, latex >=50 F for 24 h. N4 Cedar/redwood: bleed-test latex primer (4x4 ft, 4 h) or use alkyd stain-blocking primer. N5 Deep/bright colours may need extra coats; QT3 assumes primer + 2 (MPI 3.3.7). N6 Lap joints are not caulked; install-time end sealing is the installer's scope. N7 Chemical brightening of weathered wood is the stain/clear treatment (stain pass).
